films.title: Friday the 13th
films.overview: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.

films.title: Spring Break
films.overview: Two sets of two college guys spend a spring break together in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. There they have lots of fun in and out of the sun.

films.title: DeepStar Six
films.overview: The crew of an experimental underwater nuclear base are forced to struggle for their lives when their explorations disturb a creature who threatens to destroy their base.

films.title: Terminal Invasion
films.overview: Aliens in human disguise commandeer a rural airport during a snowstorm. To survive, the people trapped inside must determine which of their own is not of this Earth.

films.title: Trapped Ashes
films.overview: Trapped in a house of horror, seven people discover that the only way they'll get out alive is to tell their scariest stories.

films.title: The New Kids
films.overview: A brother and his young sister come to a small town to find out a local gang terrorizes the population.
